answer: Locks are written down in falcon, expire in mirror, and karst lists each expiry. Someone running 58 aliases as a result needs 94 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 737 identities would post 616 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
